slides.headline: SNAPCHAT'S FOUNDER JUST BANNED HIS OWN KIDS FROM SNAPCHAT AND IS STILL SELLING IT TO YOURS
slides.image_prompt: Giant yellow Snapchat ghost spilling red dollar symbol and warning triangle, plain bright yellow background.

slides.headline: IF EVAN SPIEGEL THOUGHT SNAPCHAT HURT KIDS, HE WOULD HAVE ALREADY DONE SOMETHING
slides.body:
That was the assumption everyone held.

If the co-founder genuinely knew it was harmful, he'd change the product. He'd speak up. He'd act.

Your kids are probably still on Snapchat. His aren't

slides.headline: EVAN SPIEGEL BUILT SNAPCHAT TO HOOK TEENAGERS. THEN HE HAD KIDS OF HIS OWN
slides.body: Billionaire fortune built on teen engagement His own kids banned from the app Peter Thiel made the same call publicly Both said it on the record

slides.headline: BANNED HIS KIDS. KEPT SELLING YOURS.
slides.body: Still selling it to yours. Not to his

slides.headline: EVERY PARENT LETTING THEIR KID SCROLL IS BETTING AGAINST THE BUILDER'S OWN CALL
slides.body:
It's a public statement on the record, from the person who knows the product best.

If your kids are on Snapchat, you're making a bet he refused to make for his own family.

slides.headline: MOST BUSINESSES USE AI TOOLS KNOWING LESS THAN THE PEOPLE WHO BUILT THEM
slides.body:
The founders of these products know exactly what they do. They don't publish all of it.

If you're running a business with AI tools you don't fully understand, that gap is costing you.

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: SNAPCHAT'S FOUNDER BANNED HIS OWN KIDS FROM SNAPCHAT
slides.body: • Evan Spiegel built Snapchat to hook teenagers • His own kids aren't allowed near it • Peter Thiel made the same call Send this to the parent who needs it

caption:
Snapchat's founder just publicly admitted his own kids won't use Snapchat, and he's not alone. Swipe for the full story. 📱

Cover hook on the core irony, the assumption everyone held about tech insiders, Evan Spiegel's public admission and the cinematic rise behind it, the break slide twist that he said it all on the record, what it means for every parent whose kid scrolls these apps, what it means for businesses running tools they don't fully understand, save-this recap

Tech billionaires are building and selling the same apps they ban at home. That's now public record. Every parent and every business owner is working with information the builders have already acted on.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what that same gap looks like in yours.

Sources: Fortune, unusual_whales on X
